reviews.title: Vibe coded and buggy
reviews.text:
Bizarre bugs with fantasy league behavior, I’ve had my lineup change mid gameweek without me doing anything several times now, I set my captain last night and this morning it has changed. I could be imagining it but the time zone used changed; times for match schedules or gameweek deadline sometimes will be shown in my timezone (eastern us) but sometimes it will be in, I’m assuming, GMT with no indication about which timezone I’m seeing. 
As a programmer myself these bugs are honestly just bizarre and I can’t even guess what could cause information to just change midweek. They should consider ditching Copilot.

reviews.title: No Squad Stats
reviews.text: The whole purpose I downloaded this app was to see the entire squads stats on. One page.  Instead there is only a list of players , individual player stats, or the squad as a whole stats like total number of goals.  So it makes it very difficult to use to see who the leading players are in a particular stat  or as a a League.  The NBA has a much better system that should be used as an example. You can click the match, see team vs stats, click the team summary see the starters and bench stats  for past 5 games, select advanced to see the entire season listed by season for all players with all stats, or can pick an individual player to see just theirs.  I really dislike this app as  someone who only catches soccer on TV 📺  in America once a week on NBC.

reviews.title: Terrible UI and Statistical Information
reviews.text: The app has potential, but the fantasy aspect is one the worst I have ever used. The UI is horrible. Navigating pages is tough and slow. When you want to check how well a player did in his previous game or check someone else player, I have to check the most unreadable table chart and know how to do calculus just so I can find out some dude scored 4 points. The points should update immediately and show everyone the exact points they currently have instead of waiting 2 hrs after matches have been played. Yahoo fantasy does this so I know this is possible.

reviews.title: Clunky and can’t find the info you want
reviews.text: The app is so clunky. I just want to see the scores my players got, the bonus point system and the scores. That’s it. All of this basic data is hidden away or buried in other unnecessary data. I also don’t like the constant changes to the rules. You should only ever have 2 free subs like in previous years. I feel that has been a terrible change as people can screw up and change half their team for free rather than having to wait or incur point fines. Means if you gamble and it pays off the other people in the league can just get them in for free.

reviews.title: Slow and unexciting
reviews.text:
The dullest fantasy sports experience I’ve experienced. Mates convinced us to run our league on FPL this year after using The Telegraph or Sun DreamTeam for years and I have been nothing but frustrated with this app since the start of the season.
A slow and buggy player search that gives so little info you have to click in to see what might be helpful in making transfer decisions, only to the pop back out at the top of the search you’ve just scrolled through.
Viewing your mini league is again buggy and requires tedious back and forth clicks to see what is happening.
In general the whole experience feels drab and quite basic for such a premium competition. Not a patch on any US sports fantasy apps.
Very disappointed
